title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 48
intro: Round 48 (2026-11-21). Your round-47 headings are in the guide, with the evidence tags under eight remedy headings ([what went in](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/review/r47/RESULTS-R47.md)). One card: the serotonin steps.

I can't get the serotonin steps to read Human in my words. Three tries on each pair of steps read AI, and so did four steps checked by themselves; the only part of the list that reads Human is your own step 2 ([every check](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h65-20261121/RESULTS.md)). Steps 5 and 6 are the card: how you'd say them teaches me steps 1, 3, 4, 7 and 8.

suggestions.title: 1. Act Now on SS: steps 5 and 6 (keep them still, give fluids only if)
suggestions.reading: The eight steps by themselves, as the guide has them: [AI Generated, 100%, AI High over all 326 words](https://www.pangram.com/history/2d3e8386-31e3-45f8-8968-f875710a2470).
suggestions.tested:
**Try 1**, each sentence your fixes' way (the drug list in groups, akathisia and rhabdomyolysis explained where first used, the reasons joined with "since" and "so"): steps 5 and 6 [AI High 133](https://www.pangram.com/history/25df9e03-eb53-458f-a136-c238e6650e3a).

**Try 2**, in the form of your Active Seizure list (a lead line and short items): [AI High 121](https://www.pangram.com/history/fc3db895-2d16-4e30-a626-635f44022fd1); step 5 by itself [AI High 69](https://www.pangram.com/history/d85068d3-ebac-4a40-b630-efaf22aebf26). Steps 1 and 2 together read [Human](https://www.pangram.com/history/8ad45936-f8e3-4d22-bcbc-0564508d234f), but step 1 by itself read [AI High 65](https://www.pangram.com/history/49c25418-8bd1-4238-afe2-927a59031592): it was your step 2 carrying the pair.

**Try 3**, in your first person like your step 2, after the tell panel's fixes: [AI Medium 7, AI High 122](https://www.pangram.com/history/f4275573-6c55-4088-b703-de8331ec99b9):

> Keep them still in a calm room. They're already overstimulated, so I'd clear out the crowd and stop any arguing. Pacing or exercising to "burn it off" only makes more heat, and it raises the risk of their muscles breaking down into the blood, which hurts the kidneys (rhabdomyolysis). If they feel a strong urge to keep moving (akathisia), I'd stay with them and talk them into keeping still anyway.
>
> Give fluids only if they're fully alert, able to swallow and not vomiting, and then just small sips of an electrolyte drink. But if they're confused, vomiting or sleepy, I wouldn't push anything into them, not even pills or charcoal, since they could choke. The same goes if they might have a seizure.
suggestions.sense: Three fresh readers on every try, then the tell panel twice on try 3 (Sonnet and Haiku: [first](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h65-20261121/panel-g4c/PANEL.md), [after its fixes](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h65-20261121/panel-g4c-2/PANEL.md); Codex, the panel's reader from another family, runs from your laptop, which wasn't connected). After its first fixes the panel flagged six of seven sentences: the parallel conditions ("fully alert, able to swallow and not vomiting"), the terms in brackets, the if/but pair, and the paragraph built evenly, a rule and its reason in every sentence.
suggestions.why: I can't find any more AI tells here that I can fix, and I see some human tells, like "burn it off" in your quote marks, "talk them into keeping still anyway" and "They're already overstimulated". Can you help show me the tells I'm missing? Every wording of mine reads AI, in three forms; your step 2 is the one part that reads Human. What the tell panel found: [its record](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h65-20261121/panel-g4c-2/PANEL.md).
